summary: Frontend-only test of BottomSheet drag-to-dismiss applied to the 3 collaborator kebab modals (MyHoleritesModal, MyAssetsModal, SignWithGovBrModal). All 13 acceptance criteria validated with Playwright at 420x800 viewport on /coletor?cid=col-30aafc3c.
critical_code_review_comments: BottomSheet.js: handleEnd's velocity is computed only against the LAST mousemove event before mouseup; if user drags then pauses 200ms then releases, velocity correctly reads ~0, but with very few movement events velocity may be slightly noisy. Working as expected in tests.

BottomSheet.js line 121: dragging.current is a ref so React won't re-render when its value changes — transitionStyle is recomputed on each render but during an active drag the transition is removed only via the offset-driven re-render (still works because setOffset triggers re-render). Functional, but a `useState` for `isDragging` would be cleaner.

BottomSheet.js: backdrop has touchAction:'none' which is correct, but body content uses overflowY:auto. The current design only attaches drag listeners to the small handle area, so body scroll works fine — confirmed in tests.

When SignWithGovBrModal opens on top of MyHoleritesModal, two BottomSheet backdrops/sheets stack. ESC closes only the top one (sign-govbr) because both modals add a keydown listener; the most recent listener fires first via React effect order. Verified behavior is correct in test.
MyAssetsModal.js still has an inner SignaturePad rendered as a plain fixed overlay (not a BottomSheet) — out of scope per the request, but worth noting for future consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BottomSheet UX validated. Confirmed: drag handle present in all 3 modals (data-testid='sheet-drag-handle'), ESC closes, backdrop click closes, small drag (~50px) snaps back, big drag (~60% of 598px sheet height) dismisses, fast swipe (single 100px movement) triggers velocity-based dismiss. Nested sign-govbr-modal renders with its own drag handle and ESC closes the topmost sheet first. Sheet inner testid pattern: '{testid}-sheet'.
